resources.string: For comparing. The performance hint also covers the thread that feeds the decoder; it measured no faster on our devices. Leave it off.
For foldables: sizes the decoder for the larger screen up front, so the first fold or turn needs no decoder restart. Turn it off again if video stops or shows errors.
For comparing. Takes the next screen image before each PyroWave frame arrives; it measured no faster on our devices. Leave it off.
Video data straight to the decoder
For troubleshooting. Frames go straight into the decoder, saving one copy; leave it on, and turn it off only if video stops or shows errors on this device.
For comparing. The thread that receives video runs at the decoder’s priority; it measured slower under load on our devices. Leave it off.
